title: Demon Reading
description: A black demon with horns and a long tail sits on a green table covered by a cloth. The demon looks up at three floating picture frames that show silhouettes of people under flowering branches while its hand rests on an open book with paint marks on the cover.
prompt: A black demon with horns and a long tail sits at a table covered in a green cloth and looks up at three floating picture frames. The demon's hand rests on an open book with paint marks. The frames contain silhouettes of people under flowering yellow branches. The background is a swirling blue sky filled with many eyes and a large flowering branch with yellow blossoms. Paint drips from the frames and the demon's tail.
